name: Refresh a competitive battlecard from won and lost deals
description: Run it with a competitor name, a period and the current battlecard's Google Doc ID. An AI agent reads the card and the closed-won and closed-lost Salesforce opportunities that named the competitor in that period, sorts every finding into observed or reported, and drafts a new dated version with a change log. After a person approves, the new version is saved as a separate Google Doc; the published card is never overwritten.
shortDescription: Draft a new dated battlecard version from the quarter's won and lost deals, approved before it is saved.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the battlecard-refresh skill and Google Docs and Salesforce tools
Every claim dated and marked Observed or Reported, with its source
Change log of what changed, what was added and what was dropped
New dated version saved alongside the current card, never over it
prerequisites: The `battlecard-refresh` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
Google Docs connection with access to the current battlecard
Salesforce connection with read access to Opportunity, including the field that records the competitor and the loss reason
idealFor: Product marketing and sales enablement teams that keep competitive battlecards current every quarter.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually with the competitor, the period and the current card's document ID.
Draft the refresh: the AI Agent loads the battlecard-refresh skill, reads the current card and the won and lost deals, then drafts the new version and a change log.
Approve: the run pauses until a reviewer approves the change log.
Approved: create the new dated version as a Google Doc.
Rejected: log the comment and save nothing.
